scope: Independent read-only source review and integer byte arithmetic. Only this source-safe evidence file is written. No Torch import, GPU, WSL, native import, checkpoint tensor payload, model constructor/forward, downloads, installations, or tests.

inputs.model_basis: Authenticated Stage1 metadata, not fresh model/checkpoint payload loading.

source_findings: SparseResBlockC2S3d._forward retains its original x through separate norm1/SiLU h and conv1; decoder forward also retains the incoming sparse parent until block return.
LayerNorm32 casts to F32 then restores the incoming dtype. SparseTensor.replace creates a distinct wrapper and shares coordinates/cache identity without replacing the original feature storage.
Each uncached C2S call creates independent child coordinates and gathered feature storage. Both calls receive the same strict >0 guide mask. There is no C2S cache on this admitted guided path.

Admission up_states retain all four Boolean masks and original runtime parent coordinate tables; guide_subs separately retain all four untouched BF16 guide tables and independently uploaded guide coordinates.

Source explicit-GEMM caches only the full U32[N,27] neighbor map. Hash keys/values are local to map construction and are not stored in that cache. The upper envelope nevertheless retains all five ratio2 hash pairs simultaneously.

Original x shares the first-scale spatial cache through from_latent/type/replace. The new large-map hook/patch also retain the full 438684-row map/cache and its original coordinates until cleanup. Intermediate map lifetimes are shorter, but all five full maps are charged in the envelope.

The genuine frozen Linux FlexGEMM cache is SubMConv3dNeighborCache, not a dict. Review identified and reported initial dict-only checks. Current source corrects them by authenticating the original class/source/method bytecode and requiring the same cache object with only neighbor_map; a static reread found the correction consistent with pinned source. Core CPU fixture evidence remains separately owned.

Original convolution extras are unchanged: ConvNeXt n*(16*ci+4*hidden), residual convolutions n*(16*ci+4*co), final n*(16*64+4*64). They conservatively charge full norm/SiLU/MLP/skip/residual intermediates even with low-VRAM chunking.

Original row-helper budget retains both im2col and worst-case gathered features, full and masked I64 indices, Boolean mask and tile GEMM output; full map, source feature row order and full output remain global.

retained_visible_upper_envelope.definition: A deliberately over-retained source-visible tensor envelope: all past and future support-scale tables are charged simultaneously, with two primary F16 tables per scale, every expanded-parent and skip table, all five full maps and hashes, both independent C2S coordinate families, and final F32 raw/finite-mask tables. Future planned outputs/maps/hashes are also charged again by the unchanged additional plan. This intentional double-count is conservative.
retained_visible_upper_envelope.coverage: Norm F32 casts/outputs, SiLU, hidden MLP buffers, C2S arithmetic/nonzero/clone/index temporaries, tile gathers/im2col/indices/output and residual/skip repeats are charged by the original per-site additional plan, not removed from it. Optional sparse broadcast row, seqlen and cumulative-seqlen tables are explicitly charged even though this path does not need them.
retained_visible_upper_envelope.not_a_bound_for: Reserved allocator fragmentation, backend/cuBLAS workspaces, native launch/runtime state, external allocations or host RAM. The unchanged 1GiB opaque allowance is a policy allowance, not a CPU proof that all opaque use is <=1GiB.

largest_static_projection.interpretation: Visible source envelope plus original padded plan fits the fixed cap arithmetically. This does not establish a bound on max(allocated,reserved) or current physical free VRAM. No admission, peak-memory, timing, OOM or successful execution claim follows.

decisive_retained_lower_bounds.note: These are unavoidable retained source-storage lower bounds under the new large-map hook, not measured allocator baselines. Original initial x coordinates are counted once in runtime parent coordinates; independent guide coordinates are counted separately.

historical_stage1_refusal.interpretation: Previous final-only tiling predicted conservative admission refusal before guides/coordinates/caches. New six-site tiling changes this additional budget without relaxing fixed policy.

required_runtime_gates: Authenticate the exact original profile, model F16/F32 schema, support, guide bytes, coordinates and source pins.
Use actual max(allocated,reserved) and device-free bytes at initial placement, every original convolution/C2S pre-hook, before global full-output allocation and before every tile allocation.
After native map creation, remove only the map/hash terms already in actual live/reserved baseline; after full-output creation remove only its already-live term. Preserve downstream extras.

Any missing inventory term, larger reserved baseline, device-free shortfall, unexpected cache/provenance, deadline failure or opaque pressure must refuse/stop under unchanged thresholds. A source-envelope fit cannot authorize GPU execution.
host_scope_note: This review is a VRAM/source-visible allocation audit. Prepared NumPy views can retain their entire 104148612-byte geometry container and 1814784-byte texture container; guide F32 expansions add17978176 bytes. CPU/host serialization/readback copies and host memory admission require their own unchanged checks. No host peak bound is claimed.
open_issues: No specific unaccounted source-visible tensor term or unsafe memory contract remains identified by this review. Reserved allocator/native/BLAS/external state is unmeasured, as expected for CPU qualification. A future authorized bounded attempt must pass all unchanged live admissions and retain the same1GiB opaque headroom; this CPU report supplies no runtime guarantee.
